cards.title: A world computer nobody owns
cards.text: Ethereum is a decentralized blockchain network and software platform. Since 2015 it has grown into a home for apps that run 24/7 for anyone with an internet connection — and no single person or company runs it.

cards.title: Light on the planet
cards.text: Since the Merge in September 2022, Ethereum runs on proof-of-stake. ethereum.org quotes the CCRI estimate: the Merge cut Ethereum’s yearly electricity use by more than 99.988%.

cards.title: Tips straight to the artist
cards.text: Fork the First Artist (built at ETHGlobal Mumbai, November 2026) lets a fan’s own wallet send USDC or ETH to an artist’s ENS name: 96.31% to the artist, 3.69% to their AI steward’s compute, 0% to the Open Source Orchestra. Nobody holds anyone’s money — and a sent transfer is final.

cards.title: The orchestra is whoever shows up
cards.text: The Open Source Orchestra is a circle of musicians who play open rooms at Ethereum gatherings: no auditions, no gatekeepers, no wrong instrument. From Devcon 6 in Bogotá and Devcon SEA in Bangkok to the Devcon 8 Music Sanctuary in Mumbai.

cards.title: Four days in one hall
cards.text: The Devcon 8 Music Sanctuary, Jio World Centre, Mumbai, 3–6 November 2026: cane stools in a circle, drums on rugs, a mandala of light on the wall. About 35 artists took turns at the mics; on the last evening the room held Devcon 8’s closing ceremony.

cards.title: Butterflies and Love
cards.text: “We should only wage war with butterflies and love … All we need is butterflies and love to pollinate the infinite garden.”
cards.source: Words & music by Shaka Lei Kaumaka, for Aya Miyaguchi & the Ethereum family · the ʻohana Songbook, Prelude 1

cards.title: Butterflies pollinate too
cards.text: By day they visit many wildflowers, probing for nectar — their flight fuel. They move pollen less efficiently than bees, the US Forest Service notes, but they carry it from flower to flower all the same.

cards.title: Pollinators feed us
cards.text: Nearly 90% of wild flowering plants depend, at least in part, on animals to move their pollen — and more than three quarters of the leading types of global food crops rely on animal pollination to some extent.
cards.source: IPBES pollinators assessment (2016), Summary for Policymakers, key messages A1–A2

cards.title: A Planet We Share As One
cards.text: “Protection of creation must be a collaboration of every nation — for a planet we share as one.”
cards.source: Shaka Lei Kaumaka, recorded with Ethereum Singapore · the ʻohana Songbook, Prelude 2

cards.title: A garden, not a game to win
cards.text: The Ethereum Foundation’s picture of Ethereum is an infinite garden: coordination tended like a garden, so that it may continue to thrive. In its words: “nurture and grow, but do not control, and continue to play.”

cards.title: Fork the garden
cards.text: This radio is copyleft: code AGPL-3.0-or-later, words and design CC BY-SA 4.0. Run your own door, keep the credit, keep it open. Open Source Orchestra code lives on GitHub; the Songbook and the rider are CC BY-SA 4.0 (code GPL-3.0; pit-live itself stays AGPL-3.0).
cards.source: player.html licence header · ʻohana public facts 14 Nov 2026 §6

cards.title: The floor, not the stage
cards.text: This radio carries a mixer feed, not a camera on faces. Recording needs consent: it is announced at the mixer, anyone can ask not to be on the feed, and only what was consented is archived.
cards.source: PIT LIVE protocol v0.1 §6 · PIT Standard V2

cards.title: From Madeira to Hawaiʻi
cards.text: The ukulele comes from Portugal: the little machete of Madeira sailed to Hawaiʻi on the Ravenscrag in 1879. Kala ukuleles travel with Shaka and are put in strangers’ hands — Japan, China, India, Thailand.

cards.title: Open for forking and hosting
cards.text: Musician, DJ, developer, steward, sound, translator, photographer — open jams never need an application: just come and play. Next on the road: Devcon IX, Lisbon, 12–14 October 2027 (the organisers’ dates); the orchestra hopes to bring a circle there — nothing is promised.

epigraph.text: let’s build the most epic radio player for the world to learn about ethereum, the ohana music and how to save the planet we share as one with butterflies and love pollinating the infinite garden
